This code calculates standard non-parametric circadian rest-activity (NPCRA) and light exposure metrics using a combination of custom scripting and package functions (***LightLogR***, ***suncalc***) on raw light/activity data exported from Motionware, captured with the MotionWatch8. The data have previously been scored by the researcher for periods of "participant-defined" watch-off, or visually-identified gaps of >3 hours, and sleep periods following a standardised analysis protocol. This is not mandatory but helps with the identification of watch-off periods and if you would like to compute any variables specifically in the sleep period or wake period. Although, I have added a sleep-wake detection algorithm so it is possible to just use this on the raw .csv output from Motionware. If you do not score the files, you will need to identify watch-off periods in some other way e.g. by looking for long gaps in the data, or by using the activity column to identify periods of non-wear. You can then apply the imputation function to fill in these gaps with typical values based on the time of day and week.

Also note that when I scored the files I applied Daylight Savings Time correction to all files where it was necessary.

# Helper Functions
This section includes useful functions such as a circular mean and standard deviation (SD) for clock times and a time formatting function to convert seconds to HH:MM. It also contains the log transformation and back-transformation functions.
```{r, helper-functions}
# 1. Circular Mean for clock time (B10/D5/M10/L5)
circular_mean_hours <- function(hours) {
  if (all(is.na(hours))) return(NA_real_)
  res <- as.numeric(circular::mean.circular(
    circular::circular(hours, units = "hours", template = "clock24"), 
    na.rm = TRUE
  ))
  if (res < 0) res <- res + 24
  return(res)
}

# 2. Circular SD for clock time
circular_sd_hours <- function(hours) {
  if (all(is.na(hours))) return(NA_real_)
  as.numeric(circular::sd.circular(
    circular::circular(hours, units = "hours", template = "clock24"), 
    na.rm = TRUE
  ))
}

# 3. Time formatting (Seconds to HH:MM)
format_seconds_to_hhmm <- Vectorize(function(seconds) {
  if (is.na(seconds)) return("")
  td <- lubridate::seconds_to_period(round(seconds))
  sprintf("%02d:%02d", lubridate::hour(td), lubridate::minute(td))
})

# 4. Zero-inflated log/exp for geometric mean light logic
log_zero_inflated <- function(x) log(x + 1)
exp_zero_inflated <- function(x) exp(x) - 1

# 1. Natural Photoperiod using SunCalc
get_natural_photoperiod <- function(date, lat = 51.7520, lon = -1.2577) {
  # sunrise and sunset times for the specific date and location
  sun_times <- suncalc::getSunlightTimes(
    date = date, 
    lat = lat, 
    lon = lon, 
    keep = c("sunrise", "sunset"), 
    tz = "GMT"
  )
  # Calculate duration in minutes
  as.numeric(difftime(sun_times$sunset, sun_times$sunrise, units = "mins"))
}
```

# Imputation Function
This function fills gaps in both light and activity columns by calculating a Time-of-Day (TOD) median. Note that the same gaps were identified across light and activity in this process (i.e. gap cleaning occurred once manually). It identifies every minute of the week (0-1439), finds the median value for that specific minute from all other valid days in the same week, and uses that "typical" value to replace the "watch-off" gaps. 
```{r,imputation-functions}
.to_num <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))

safe_median <- function(x) {
  x <- .to_num(x); x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (!length(x)) return(NA_real_)
  stats::median(x)
}

normalize_bool <- function(x) {
  if (is.logical(x)) return(x)
  if (is.factor(x))  x <- as.character(x)
  if (is.numeric(x) || is.integer(x)) return(ifelse(is.na(x), NA, x != 0))
  if (is.character(x)) {
    z <- tolower(trimws(x))
    return(dplyr::case_when(
      z %in% c("1","true","t","yes","y") ~ TRUE,
      z %in% c("0","false","f","no","n") ~ FALSE,
      TRUE ~ NA
    ))
  }
  rep(NA, length(x))
}

build_tod_medians <- function(df, week_col, tod_col, value_col, eligible_col, offwrist_col = NULL, use_offwrist = FALSE) {
  elig  <- (!is.na(df[[eligible_col]])) & (df[[eligible_col]] == TRUE)
  vals   <- .to_num(df[[value_col]])
  donors <- elig & is.finite(vals)
  
  med <- df |>
    dplyr::filter(donors) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      WeekIndex = as.integer(.data[[week_col]]),
      TOD_min   = as.integer(.data[[tod_col]]),
      value     = .to_num(.data[[value_col]])
    ) |>
    dplyr::group_by(.data$WeekIndex, .data$TOD_min) |>
    dplyr::summarise(TOD_med = safe_median(.data$value), .groups = "drop")
  return(med)
}

apply_tod_impute <- function(df, week_col, tod_col, value_col, eligible_col, med_tbl, out_col) {
  by_map <- setNames(c("WeekIndex", "TOD_min"), c(week_col, tod_col))
  out_df <- df |> dplyr::left_join(med_tbl, by = by_map)
  
  elig <- (!is.na(out_df[[eligible_col]])) & (out_df[[eligible_col]] == TRUE)
  val  <- .to_num(out_df[[value_col]])
  med  <- .to_num(out_df[["TOD_med"]])
  
  out_df[[out_col]] <- ifelse(elig & is.finite(val), val,
                       ifelse(elig & !is.finite(val) & is.finite(med), med, NA_real_))
  out_df[["TOD_med"]] <- NULL
  return(out_df)
}

npcra_impute_strict <- function(df, week_col, tod_col, value_col, eligible_col, out_col, fallback = "none") {
  med_primary <- build_tod_medians(df, week_col, tod_col, value_col, eligible_col)
  out_df <- apply_tod_impute(df, week_col, tod_col, value_col, eligible_col, med_primary, out_col)
  
  # QC Check
  qc <- out_df |>
    dplyr::group_by(.data[[week_col]]) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_eligible = sum(.data[[eligible_col]] == TRUE),
      n_filled = sum(!is.na(.data[[out_col]]) & .data[[eligible_col]] == TRUE),
      coverage = n_filled / n_eligible
    )
  
  return(list(data = out_df, qc = qc))
}
```

# 1. Load and clean the raw actigraphy .csv files
This code reads in the raw activity/light MotionWatch8 files exported from Motionware. It assigns all periods where the researcher has defined as "watch-off" (999999) to NA, so that the gaps are explicit. It counts the number of rows to ensure that the row length stays consistent. The code also converts the date and time columns from Excel format to a proper datetime column. It also changes the column names to those expected by the LightLogR package e.g. Datetime, Light, Id. It also assigns the correct timepoints and weeks to each row based on the filename and the date of recording. Finally, it saves the cleaned data to a new .csv file in the processed data directory for use in the next steps, or further analysis.
```{r, 1-load-clean-data, message=FALSE, warning = FALSE}

# LOAD REQUIRED PACKAGES
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(hms)
library(lubridate)

# SET PATHS
path_to_files <- here::here("Data/raw/actigraphy/")
file_list <- list.files(path = path_to_files, pattern = "\\.xlsx$", full.names = TRUE)

# FUNCTION TO READ AND PREP INDIVIDUAL FILES
read_and_prep <- function(file) {
  filename <- basename(file)
  
  # Extract metadata directly
  p_id <- substr(filename, 1, 2)
  tp   <- substr(filename, 4, 6)
  
  read_excel(file, sheet = 3) %>%
    transmute(
      id        = sprintf("%03d", as.numeric(p_id)),
      Timepoint = tp,
      Date      = as_date(Date),
      Time      = as_hms(Time),
      Datetime  = as_datetime(paste(Date, Time)),
      light     = as.numeric(`Light (lux)`),
      activity  = as.numeric(`Activity (MW counts)`)
    )
}

# MAIN PIPELINE
processed_data <- file_list %>%
  map_dfr(read_and_prep) %>%
  group_by(id, Timepoint) %>%
  # Calculate Day relative to start of that specific timepoint
  mutate(Day = as.numeric(Date - min(Date, na.rm = TRUE)) + 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Filter based on timepoint constraints
  filter(
    (Timepoint == "BSL" & Day <= 14) | 
    (Timepoint == "SRT" & Day <= 28)
  ) %>%
  # Assign weeks in one step
  mutate(
    week = case_when(
      Timepoint == "BSL" ~ "BSL",
      Timepoint == "SRT" ~ as.character(ceiling(Day / 7)),
      TRUE               ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Data Cleaning: Replace watch-off (999999) with explicit NAs
rows_to_modify <- processed_data$activity == 999999
processed_data$activity[rows_to_modify] <- NA
processed_data$light[rows_to_modify] <- NA

# Convert the Excel date/time formats and create the final Datetime column
combined_data_clean <- processed_data%>%
  mutate(
    activity = as.numeric(activity),
    light = as.numeric(light))

#save to excel output directory as csv
write_csv(combined_data_clean, here("Data", "processed", "light", "cleaned_light_data.csv"))
  
```

# 2. Visualise the Data and Any Missing Data
This analysis visualises light exposure and identifies data loss using a standardised temporal axis. By normalising each recording to Days from Start, we enable a direct comparison of monitoring duration across participants and timepoints. The following visualisation employs a logarithmic scale ($log_{10}$) to capture the wide dynamic range of light intensity, from dim nocturnal levels to bright daylight. Integrated "gap detection" logic identifies periods of missing data ($NA$ values) exceeding a 6-minute threshold ($0.1$ hours), which are highlighted as red background blocks to provide a visulisation of sensor reliability and recording continuity.
```{r, 2-gap-visualisation, fig.width=10, fig.height=20}

library(patchwork)
library(tidyverse)

## 1. Filter and prepare the data
audit_final <- combined_data_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(Timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(id = factor(id), Timepoint = factor(Timepoint)) %>% 
  group_by(id, Timepoint) %>%
  mutate(
    Start_Time = min(Datetime, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Changed units to "days"
    Days_From_Start = as.numeric(difftime(Datetime, Start_Time, units = "days"))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 2. Extract Red Gap Data
red_gaps_master <- audit_final %>%
  filter(is.na(light)) %>%
  # We adjust the gap threshold: 0.1 hours is ~0.00417 days
  group_by(id, Timepoint, grp = cumsum(c(1, diff(Days_From_Start) > (0.1/24)))) %>% 
  summarise(start = min(Days_From_Start), end = max(Days_From_Start), .groups = "drop")

# 1. Map original IDs to Letters A-Q
unique_ids <- unique(audit_final$id)

id_lookup <- tibble(
  id = unique_ids,
  # This creates "ID A", "ID B", etc.
  masked_id = factor(paste(LETTERS[1:length(unique_ids)]),
                     levels = paste(LETTERS[1:length(unique_ids)]))
)

# 2. Apply the mask to both datasets
audit_masked <- audit_final %>%
  left_join(id_lookup, by = "id")

red_gaps_masked <- red_gaps_master %>%
  left_join(id_lookup, by = "id")

# --- Plot A: Light (Black, Log Scale) ---
plot_light <- ggplot(audit_masked, aes(x = Days_From_Start)) +
  geom_rect(data = red_gaps_masked, 
            aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = 0, ymax = Inf), 
            fill = "red", alpha = 0.3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_line(aes(y = light), color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  facet_grid(masked_id ~ Timepoint, scales = "free_x") + 
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "A: Light Exposure", y = "Lux (Log10)", x = NULL) +
  theme(
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  )

# --- Plot B: Activity (Dark Blue, Adjusted Scale) ---
plot_activity <- ggplot(audit_masked, aes(x = Days_From_Start)) +
  geom_rect(data = red_gaps_masked, 
            aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = 0, ymax = Inf), 
            fill = "red", alpha = 0.3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_line(aes(y = activity), color = "darkblue", linewidth = 0.2) +
  # Using sqrt scale to "zoom in" on low activity while keeping peaks visible
  scale_y_sqrt() + 
  facet_grid(masked_id ~ Timepoint, scales = "free_x") + 
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "B: Activity Counts", y = "Counts (sqrt scale)", x = "Days from Start") +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0))

# --- 2. Combine with Patchwork ---
composite_audit <- (plot_light / plot_activity) + 
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"))
  )

composite_audit
# --- 1. Define the Directory ---
light_fig_dir <- here::here("Figures", "NPCRA_and_light")

# Create the folder if it doesn't exist yet
if (!dir.exists(light_fig_dir)) {
  dir.create(light_fig_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

# --- 2. Save the Figure ---
# Saving as both PNG and TIFF for some journals
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(light_fig_dir, paste0("Light_Activity_Plot",  ".png")),
  plot = composite_audit,
  width = 18,
  height = 20,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(light_fig_dir, paste0("Light_Activity_Plot",  ".tiff")),
  plot = composite_audit,
  width = 18,
  height = 20,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  compression = "lzw",
  bg = "white"
)

cat("Success! Combined plots saved to:", light_fig_dir)
```


# 3. Quality Control
This section evaluates the integrity of the light column data to ensure only high-quality recordings proceed to further analysis. It flags and excludes watch files based on two criteria: sensor covering (too dark for >80% of the time), or sensor malfunction/saturation (too bright for >75% of the time). This is based on the exclusions in [Burns et al. (2023)](https://doi.org/10.1038/s44220-023-00135-8).
```{r, 3-qc-light, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# 1. Hardware QC (Sensor Integrity)
qc_hardware <- combined_data_clean %>%
  group_by(id, Timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    n_valid_readings = sum(!is.na(light)),
    pct_below_10 = (sum(light < 10, na.rm = TRUE) / n_valid_readings) * 100,
    pct_above_6000 = (sum(light > 6000, na.rm = TRUE) / n_valid_readings) * 100,
    Sensor_Exclusion = case_when(
      pct_below_10 > 80   ~ "Too dark (>80% <10lx)",
      pct_above_6000 > 75 ~ "Too bright (>75% >6000lx)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ), .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2. Protocol Validation (3-hour / 4-day rule)
daily_validity <- combined_data_clean %>%
  left_join(qc_hardware %>% select(id, Timepoint, Sensor_Exclusion), by = c("id", "Timepoint")) %>%
  filter(is.na(Sensor_Exclusion)) %>% 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Datetime)) %>%
  group_by(id, Timepoint, week, Date) %>%
  summarise(
    hours_missing = sum(is.na(light)) / 60,
    is_day_valid = hours_missing < 3, 
    .groups = "drop"
  )

week_validity <- daily_validity %>%
  group_by(id, Timepoint, week) %>%
  summarise(
    valid_days_count = sum(is_day_valid),
    is_week_valid = valid_days_count >= 4,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 3. Create Registries
daily_registry <- daily_validity %>%
  left_join(week_validity, by = c("id", "Timepoint", "week")) %>%
  filter(is_day_valid & is_week_valid) %>%
  distinct(id, Timepoint, week, Date)
# IS/IV Registry (Consecutive streaks for stability metrics)
is_iv_registry <- daily_validity %>%
  filter(is_day_valid) %>%
  arrange(id, Timepoint, week, Date) %>%
  group_by(id, Timepoint, week) %>%
  mutate(is_streak = if(n() >= 4) {
    slider::slide_lgl(Date, ~length(.x) == 4 && all(diff(.x) == 1), .before = 3, .complete = TRUE)
  } else { FALSE }) %>%
  mutate(keep = is_streak | lead(is_streak, 1, default=F) | lead(is_streak, 2, default=F) | lead(is_streak, 3, default=F)) %>%
  filter(keep == TRUE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(id, Timepoint, week, Date)

# 4. Final Filtered Dataset for Imputation
combined_data_included_light <- combined_data_clean %>%
  inner_join(daily_registry, by = c("id", "Timepoint", "week", "Date"))
```


# 4. Identify Missing Data, Select Valid Days and Weeks
This section identifies irregularities and gaps in the light data to establish a valid dataset based on missingness. It begins by mapping missing data patterns by hour and participant for transparency. To ensure statistical reliability, the code applies a 3-hour missingness guard, flagging any day with more than three hours *total* of missing data for exclusion. Finally, it utilises a sliding window to enforce a 4-day consecutive streak rule, retaining only continuous blocks of light data. The 4 day consecutive rule is for IS/IV metrics only, whereas the 4 valid days (does not need to be consecutive) is for all other metrics. The process concludes with an automated exclusion and validation report that documents the reasons for any participant/data loss prior to final analysis. It also generates a heat map showing where the data are missing for each participant.
```{r, 4-data-quality, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=14}
# 1. Summary Registry Stats
light_streak_stats <- daily_validity %>%
  filter(is_day_valid) %>%
  group_by(id, week) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Valid_Days = n(),
    Longest_Streak = {
      if(n() < 2) n() else {
        runs <- rle(as.numeric(diff(Date)))
        if(any(runs$values == 1)) max(runs$lengths[runs$values == 1]) + 1 else 1
      }
    }, .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2. Detailed Audit Table
light_audit_ft <- daily_validity %>%
  group_by(id, week) %>%
  summarise(Avg_Gap = mean(hours_missing), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(light_streak_stats, by = c("id", "week")) %>%
  mutate(Status = case_when(
    Longest_Streak >= 4 ~ "✅ Kept (All Metrics)",
    Total_Valid_Days >= 4 ~ "⚠️ Daily Only",
    TRUE ~ "❌ Excluded"
  )) %>%
  flextable() %>% theme_vanilla() %>% autofit()

htmltools::div(style = "height: 400px; overflow-y: scroll;", htmltools_value(light_audit_ft))

# 3. Heatmap
combined_data_included_light %>%
  mutate(Time = hms::as_hms(Datetime), Date = as.Date(Datetime)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Time, y = Date)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = log10(light + 1))) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", na.value = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~id, ncol = 5, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal() + labs(title = "Validated Data Heatmap")

# --- 1. Helper Function for Inclusion Table ---
get_phase_counts <- function(df, level_name) {
  df %>%
    mutate(Phase = ifelse(week == "BSL", "BSL", "SRT")) %>%
    group_by(Phase) %>%
    summarise(
      Level = level_name,
      Participants = n_distinct(id),
      Weeks = n_distinct(id, week),
      Valid_Days = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# --- 2. Calculate Attrition across Registries ---
# Initial: Everything that passed the sensor integrity check
initial_counts <- daily_validity %>% 
  get_phase_counts("1. Post-Hardware QC")

# Daily: Passed 3-hour guard AND 4-day week rule
daily_counts <- daily_registry %>% 
  get_phase_counts("2. Daily Metrics Registry")

# IS/IV: Passed 3-hour guard AND 4-day consecutive streak rule
is_iv_counts <- is_iv_registry %>% 
  get_phase_counts("3. IS/IV (Strict) Registry")

# --- 3. Render Inclusion Split Table ---
inclusion_split_ft <- bind_rows(initial_counts, daily_counts, is_iv_counts) %>%
  select(Level, Phase, Participants, Weeks, Valid_Days) %>%
  flextable() %>%
  set_header_labels(
    Level = "Analysis Level",
    Weeks = "Included Weeks",
    Valid_Days = "Total Valid Days"
  ) %>%
  merge_v(j = "Level") %>% 
  theme_vanilla() %>%
  bg(i = ~ Phase == "BSL", bg = "#f9f9f9", part = "body") %>%
  bold(i = ~ Level == "1. Post-Hardware QC", j = 1) %>%
  autofit()

# Display Table
inclusion_split_ft

# --- 4. Detailed Participant Audit (Scrollable) ---
light_streak_stats <- daily_validity %>%
  filter(is_day_valid) %>%
  group_by(id, week) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Valid = n(),
    Longest_Streak = {
      if(n() < 2) n() else {
        runs <- rle(as.numeric(diff(Date)))
        if(any(runs$values == 1)) max(runs$lengths[runs$values == 1]) + 1 else 1
      }
    }, .groups = "drop"
  )

light_audit_ft <- daily_validity %>%
  group_by(id, week) %>%
  summarise(Avg_Gap_Hrs = mean(hours_missing), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(light_streak_stats, by = c("id", "week")) %>%
  mutate(Status = case_when(
    Longest_Streak >= 4 ~ "✅ All Metrics",
    Total_Valid >= 4    ~ "⚠️ Daily Only",
    TRUE                ~ "❌ Excluded"
  )) %>%
  flextable() %>% theme_vanilla() %>% autofit()

htmltools::div(style = "height: 400px; overflow-y: scroll; border: 1px solid #ddd;", 
               htmltools_value(light_audit_ft))
```

# 5. Imputation Implementation
This section takes the imputation function and applies it to our dataset. Note that both light and activity columns are imputed separately.
```{r, 5-imputation}
# --- 1. Filter to Valid Data Only ---
# Only attempt to impute gaps in days that passed the 3-hour/4-day protocol
final_imputed_all <- combined_data_clean %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Datetime)) %>%
  inner_join(daily_registry, by = c("id", "Timepoint", "week", "Date")) %>%
  mutate(TOD_min = hour(Datetime) * 60 + minute(Datetime))

# --- 2. Calculate Medians (Donor Profiles) ---
# Medians are calculated from 'clean' valid days only
final_imputed_all <- final_imputed_all %>%
  group_by(id, week, TOD_min) %>%
  mutate(
    weekly_med_light = median(light, na.rm = TRUE),
    weekly_med_act   = median(activity, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  group_by(id, TOD_min) %>%
  mutate(
    global_med_light = median(light, na.rm = TRUE),
    global_med_act   = median(activity, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# --- 3. Execute Hierarchical Imputation ---
# Keep real data -> Try Weekly Median -> Fallback to Global Median
final_imputed_all <- final_imputed_all %>%
  mutate(
    light_imputed = case_when(
      !is.na(light) ~ light,
      !is.na(weekly_med_light) ~ weekly_med_light,
      TRUE ~ global_med_light 
    ),
    activity_imputed = case_when(
      !is.na(activity) ~ activity,
      !is.na(weekly_med_act) ~ weekly_med_act,
      TRUE ~ global_med_act
    )
  )

final_imputed_all <- final_imputed_all %>%
  filter(!(id == "001" & Timepoint == "SRT" & Date < (min(Date) + 7)))

# --- 5. Final Verification ---
na_check <- sum(is.na(final_imputed_all$light_imputed))
cat(paste("Imputation complete. Remaining NAs in light_imputed:", na_check, "\n"))
```

# 6. Visualise The Impact of Imputation on Light
Now we can plot the data again, but this time we can see that the red gaps are filled in. The heatmap still contains some white space. These are areas where the watch was not worn e.g. lead in time for a new watch given. Note again that this just shows us the light column, not the activity column.

# 9. Sleep period data
```{r, 9-sleep-periods}
# ==============================================================================
# 10. ACTIGRAPHY PROCESSING: DATES & CLOCK-TIME CONVERSION
# ==============================================================================
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(here)
library(hms)

# --- 1. Load All Raw Files ---
path_to_files <- here("Data", "raw", "actigraphy")
file_list <- list.files(path = path_to_files, pattern = "\\.xlsx$", full.names = TRUE)

if (length(file_list) == 0) stop("No .xlsx files found in the specified path.")

data_list <- list()
for (file in file_list) {
  fname <- basename(file)
  data <- read_excel(file, sheet = 1) %>%
    mutate(id = substr(fname, 1, 2), 
           Timepoint = substr(fname, 4, 6))
  data_list[[fname]] <- data
}

# --- 2. Initial Tidying & Date Extraction ---
actigraphy_raw <- bind_rows(data_list) %>%
  rename(Variable = Day) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = matches("^[0-9]+$"), names_to = "Day", values_to = "Value") %>%
  mutate(Day = as.integer(Day))

# Create Date Mapping (Excel serial to R Date) 
date_mapping <- actigraphy_raw %>%
  filter(Variable == "Start day") %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(as.numeric(Value), origin = "1899-12-30")) %>%
  select(id, Timepoint, Day, Date)

# --- 3. Variable Recoding & Unit Conversion ---
# Define clock-time variables for conversion
time_vars <- c("Lights out", "Fell asleep", "Woke up", "Got up")

final_combined_data <- actigraphy_raw %>%
  filter(!Variable %in% c("Start day", "End day", "Day of week")) %>%
  mutate(Week = case_when(
    Timepoint == "BSL" ~ "BSL", 
    Timepoint == "SRT" & Day <= 7 ~ "1",
    Timepoint == "SRT" & Day <= 14 ~ "2",
    Timepoint == "SRT" & Day <= 21 ~ "3",
    Timepoint == "SRT" & Day <= 28 ~ "4",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  mutate(Variable = fct_recode(Variable, 
                               "TST" = "Actual sleep time", "TIB" = "Time in bed",
                               "SOL" = "Sleep latency", "SE" = "Sleep efficiency (%)",
                               "midpoint_sleep" = "Central Phase Measure (min)",
                               "Wake(%)" = "Actual wake (%)", "WASO" = "Actual wake time",
                               "Wake_bouts" = "Wake bouts", "Mean_wake_bout" = "Mean wake bout")) %>%
  # Merge the extracted Dates
  left_join(date_mapping, by = c("id", "Timepoint", "Day")) %>%
  mutate(Value = as.numeric(Value)) %>%
  # --- 4. Unit and Clock-Time Conversion ---
  mutate(
    # Convert Durations to Minutes
    Value = if_else(Variable %in% c("TST", "TIB", "SOL", "WASO", "Mean_wake_bout"), 
                    Value * 1440, Value),
    # Convert Decimals to hms Clock-Time 
    Clock_Time = if_else(Variable %in% time_vars, 
                         as_hms(Value * 86400), 
                         as_hms(NA))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Value))

# --- 5. Report & Save ---
cat("## ✅ Actigraphy Data Cleaned with Calendar Dates and Clock Times\n")
print(head(final_combined_data %>% select(id, Variable, Day, Date, Value, Clock_Time)))

# ==============================================================================
# 11. CALCULATION OF WAKE PERIOD ACTIVITY & LIGHT
# ==============================================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr)

# --- 1. HELPERS ---
log_zero_inflated <- function(x) log(x + 1)
exp_zero_inflated <- function(x) exp(x) - 1

log_geom_mean <- function(x) {
  if(length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) return(NA_real_)
  exp(mean(log_zero_inflated(x), na.rm = TRUE)) - 1
}

# --- 2. PREPARE SLEEP PERIODS ---
sleep_timing_base <- final_combined_data %>%
  select(id, Timepoint, Week, Day, Date, Variable, Clock_Time) %>%
  filter(Variable %in% c("Lights out", "Got up")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Variable, values_from = Clock_Time) %>%
  mutate(id = str_pad(as.character(as.numeric(id)), 3, pad = "0"),
         Day = as.numeric(Day)) %>%
  arrange(id, Day) %>% 
  group_by(id, Timepoint) %>%
  mutate(
    # Segmentation for non-consecutive days
    day_diff = Day - lag(Day, default = first(Day)),
    block_start = ifelse(day_diff > 1, 1, 0),
    segment_id = cumsum(block_start),
    # Timing anchors
    wake_start = as.POSIXct(paste(Date, `Got up`), tz = "UTC"),
    wake_end_date = if_else(`Lights out` < `Got up`, Date + days(1), Date),
    wake_end = as.POSIXct(paste(wake_end_date, `Lights out`), tz = "UTC"),
    # 4-hour windows
    pre_bed_start = wake_end - hours(4),
    post_wake_end = wake_start + hours(4),
    wake_duration_hrs = as.numeric(difftime(wake_end, wake_start, units = "hours"))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# --- 3. ALIGN SENSOR DATA (final_imputed_all) ---
sensor_data_clean <- final_imputed_all %>%
  # Ensure ID is also 3 digits just in case
  mutate(id = str_pad(as.character(as.numeric(id)), 3, pad = "0"),
         Day = as.numeric(Day))

# --- 4. CALCULATION 
wake_metrics_processed <- sensor_data_clean %>%
  # Join on the primary anchors (id, Timepoint, Day)
  inner_join(sleep_timing_base, by = c("id", "Timepoint", "Day")) %>%
  group_by(id, Timepoint, Week, Day, Date.y, segment_id, wake_start, wake_end, 
           pre_bed_start, post_wake_end, wake_duration_hrs) %>%
  summarise(
    # Full Wake Period
    mean_wake_act   = mean(activity_imputed[Datetime >= wake_start & Datetime < wake_end], na.rm = TRUE),
    geom_wake_light = log_geom_mean(light_imputed[Datetime >= wake_start & Datetime < wake_end]),
    
    # 4h Pre-Bed
    mean_prebed_act   = mean(activity_imputed[Datetime >= pre_bed_start & Datetime < wake_end], na.rm = TRUE),
    geom_prebed_light = log_geom_mean(light_imputed[Datetime >= pre_bed_start & Datetime < wake_end]),
    
    # 4h Post-Wake
    mean_postwake_act   = mean(activity_imputed[Datetime >= wake_start & Datetime < post_wake_end], na.rm = TRUE),
    geom_postwake_light = log_geom_mean(light_imputed[Datetime >= wake_start & Datetime < post_wake_end]),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(Date = Date.y)

# --- 5. REPORT ---
cat(paste("Total participants processed:", n_distinct(wake_metrics_processed$id), "\n"))
cat(paste("Total wake periods calculated:", nrow(wake_metrics_processed), "\n"))

print(head(wake_metrics_processed))

# --- 1. Aggregate daily transition metrics to weekly participant level ---
wake_window_weekly <- wake_metrics_processed %>%
  # FIX: Standardise Week labels for BSL
  mutate(week = case_when(
    Timepoint == "BSL" ~ "BSL", # Force all BSL days to the "BSL" category
    TRUE ~ as.character(Week)    # Keep SRT as 1, 2, 3, 4
  )) %>%
  group_by(id, week) %>% 
  summarise(across(c(mean_wake_act, geom_wake_light, mean_prebed_act, 
                     geom_prebed_light, mean_postwake_act, geom_postwake_light, 
                     wake_duration_hrs), mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  rename(avg_wake_act = mean_wake_act, avg_wake_light = geom_wake_light,
         avg_prebed_act = mean_prebed_act, avg_prebed_light = geom_prebed_light,
         avg_postwake_act = mean_postwake_act, avg_postwake_light = geom_postwake_light,
         avg_wake_duration = wake_duration_hrs)
```

# 7. Compute the Light Metrics
This section executes a custom pipeline designed to extract rest-activity rhythm markers and light metrics. This process employs a 24-hour template-matching approach to standardise every recording day to exactly 1,440 minutes, preventing bias from partial-day recordings. For all metrics, data are aggregated hourly before calculation. 

The code calculates the M10 (most active 10 hours) and L5 (least active 5 hours) for activity, alongside the B10 (brightest 10 hours) and D5 (darkest 5 hours) for light exposure using the function *bright_dark_period* from LightLogR. Light intensity values undergo a logarithmic transformation ($\log_{10}(x + 1)$) prior to averaging. This log-transform normalises the skewed distribution of light and ensures that the resulting Geometric Means accurately reflect light exposure rather than being disproportionately weighted by transient, extreme lux peaks. Furthermore, all temporal onsets and midpoints are derived using Circular Statistics to ensure accurate time-averaging across the midnight threshold.

We compute the photoperiod for each day using the *suncalc* package, which provides sunrise and sunset times based on the date and geographic location (Oxfordshire). The photoperiod is calculated as the duration between sunrise and sunset in minutes. 

We also calculate Relative Amplitude (RA) and Interdaily Stability (IS) and Intradaily Variability (IV) for both activity and light. To ensure compatibility with standard methods [Van Someren et al. (1999)](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/10442243/).), these metrics are computed using the *LightLogR* package with data binned into 60-minute intervals already by the function. IS and IV are computed only on full 24 hour days, thus they use a more conservative dataset than the other metrics.

All metrics are computed at the daily level before averaging per week (BSL, 1-4). 
```{r, 7-compute-light-metrics}
library(suncalc)
# ==============================================================================
# 7. UPDATED MASTER METRICS FUNCTION
# ==============================================================================

library(LightLogR)

compute_master_metrics_imputed <- function(df, light_col = "light_imputed", act_col = "activity_imputed", raw_light_col = "light") {
  
  # --- Step A: Daily Level ---
  daily_stats <- df %>%
    group_by(id, week, Date = as.Date(Datetime)) %>%
    reframe({
      l_vec <- as.numeric(pick(all_of(light_col))[[1]])
      a_vec <- as.numeric(pick(all_of(act_col))[[1]])
      dt <- Datetime
      current_date <- Date[1]
      
      if(length(dt) == 1440) {
        sun <- suncalc::getSunlightTimes(date = current_date, lat = 51.7520, lon = -1.2577, keep = c("sunrise", "sunset"))
        
        m10_act <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(bright_dark_period(a_vec, dt, "brightest", "10 hours", as.df=T)), error = function(e) NULL)
        l5_act  <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(bright_dark_period(a_vec, dt, "darkest", "5 hours", as.df=T)), error = function(e) NULL)
        b10_li  <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(bright_dark_period(log_zero_inflated(l_vec), dt, "brightest", "10 hours", as.df=T)), error = function(e) NULL)
        d5_li   <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(bright_dark_period(log_zero_inflated(l_vec), dt, "darkest", "5 hours", as.df=T)), error = function(e) NULL)
        
        if(!is.null(m10_act) && !is.null(l5_act) && !is.null(b10_li) && !is.null(d5_li)) {
          idx_250 <- which(l_vec >= 250)
          d_flit_250 = if(length(idx_250) > 0) as.numeric(hms::as_hms(dt[min(idx_250)])) / 3600 else NA
          d_llit_250 = if(length(idx_250) > 0) as.numeric(hms::as_hms(dt[max(idx_250)])) / 3600 else NA
          d_mlit_250 = if(length(idx_250) > 0) circular_mean_hours(as.numeric(hms::as_hms(dt[idx_250])) / 3600) else NA

          tibble(
            d_m10_act_val = m10_act$brightest_10h_mean,
            d_m10_start   = as.numeric(hms::as_hms(m10_act$brightest_10h_onset))/3600,
            d_l5_act_val  = l5_act$darkest_5h_mean,
            d_l5_start    = as.numeric(hms::as_hms(l5_act$darkest_5h_onset))/3600,
            d_b10_li_val  = b10_li$brightest_10h_mean,
            d_b10_start   = as.numeric(hms::as_hms(b10_li$brightest_10h_onset))/3600,
            d_d5_li_val   = d5_li$darkest_5h_mean,
            d_d5_start    = as.numeric(hms::as_hms(d5_li$darkest_5h_onset))/3600,
            flit_250 = d_flit_250, llit_250 = d_llit_250, mlit_250 = d_mlit_250,
            dose_hrs = sum(l_vec, na.rm = TRUE) / 60,
            d_tat500  = sum(l_vec >= 500, na.rm = T), 
            d_tat1000 = sum(l_vec >= 1000, na.rm = T),
            d_photo   = as.numeric(difftime(sun$sunset, sun$sunrise, units = "mins")),
            d_miss    = sum(is.na(pick(all_of(raw_light_col)))) / 1440
          )
        } else { tibble() }
      } else { tibble() }
    })

  # --- Step B: Rhythm Metrics ---
  rhythm_stats <- df %>%
    group_by(id, week, Date = as.Date(Datetime)) %>%
    filter(n() == 1440) %>% 
    group_by(id, week) %>%
    summarise(
      n_complete_days = as.numeric(n_distinct(Date)), 
      IS_act = interdaily_stability(!!sym(act_col), Datetime),
      IV_act = intradaily_variability(!!sym(act_col), Datetime),
      IS_light = interdaily_stability(!!sym(light_col), Datetime),
      IV_light = intradaily_variability(!!sym(light_col), Datetime),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # --- Step C: Weekly Aggregation (Including Streak) ---
  weekly_gen <- daily_stats %>%
    group_by(id, week) %>%
    arrange(Date) %>%
    mutate(
      # Calculate Streak: Identify groups of consecutive dates
      diff_date = c(1, diff(Date)),
      new_streak = diff_date > 1,
      streak_id = cumsum(new_streak)
    ) %>%
    group_by(id, week, streak_id) %>%
    mutate(streak_len = n()) %>%
    group_by(id, week) %>%
    summarise(
      n_valid_days = n(),
      avg_streak = mean(streak_len), # Average length of consecutive blocks
      avg_daily_missing = mean(d_miss, na.rm=T),
      Photo_avg = mean(d_photo, na.rm = T),
      M10_act_avg = mean(d_m10_act_val, na.rm=T)*60,
      L5_act_avg  = mean(d_l5_act_val, na.rm=T)*60,
      M10_start_hour = circular_mean_hours(d_m10_start),
      L5_start_hour  = circular_mean_hours(d_l5_start),
      RA_act = (M10_act_avg - L5_act_avg)/(M10_act_avg + L5_act_avg),
      B10_GM_lux = exp_zero_inflated(mean(d_b10_li_val, na.rm=T)),
      D5_GM_lux  = exp_zero_inflated(mean(d_d5_li_val, na.rm=T)),
      B10_start_hour = circular_mean_hours(d_b10_start),
      D5_start_hour  = circular_mean_hours(d_d5_start),
      RA_light = (B10_GM_lux - D5_GM_lux)/(B10_GM_lux + D5_GM_lux),
      Dose_Lux_Hrs = mean(dose_hrs, na.rm = TRUE),
      FLiT_250_avg = circular_mean_hours(flit_250),
      MLiT_250_avg = circular_mean_hours(mlit_250),
      LLiT_250_avg = circular_mean_hours(llit_250),
      TAT_500_avg  = mean(d_tat500, na.rm = T),
      TAT_1000_avg = mean(d_tat1000, na.rm = T),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(n_valid_days >= 4) # Applying my 4-day rule

  left_join(weekly_gen, rhythm_stats, by = c("id", "week"))
}

# ==============================================================================
# 8. DEFINE LOOKUP 
# ==============================================================================
```

# 8. LRI and SRI
```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# SRI and LRI
# ==============================================================================
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(slider)
library(hms)

# 1.1. Philips Weighting Vector for Activity
philips_oakley_weights <- function(x) {
  if(length(x) < 9) return(NA_real_) 
  weights <- c(0.04, 0.04, 0.2, 0.2, 2.0, 0.2, 0.2, 0.04, 0.04)
  return(sum(x * weights))
}

# 1.2. Run Pure 24h Automated State Detection Across Raw Epochs
regularity_timeline_prepped <- final_imputed_all %>%
  mutate(
    id = str_pad(as.character(as.numeric(id)), 3, pad = "0"),
    Timepoint = as.character(Timepoint),
    Day = as.numeric(Day)
  ) %>%
  select(-any_of(c("philips_tac", "sleep_binary", "light_binary"))) %>%
  arrange(id, Datetime) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  mutate(
    # Smooth activity counts using native rolling windows
    philips_tac = slide_dbl(activity_imputed, philips_oakley_weights, .before = 4, .after = 4),
    philips_tac = if_else(is.na(philips_tac), activity_imputed, philips_tac),
    
    # NO LOGS DIARY: Score as sleep ONLY if movement is low AND light is low (<50 lux)
    # This automatically protects daytime desk-sitting from being marked as sleep.
    sleep_binary = if_else(philips_tac <= 40 & light_imputed < 50, 1, 0),
    
    # Light Scoring (Pure 24h Threshold)
    light_binary = if_else(light_imputed > 100, 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 1.3. Time-Matched 24h Regularity Index Calculator (Standard 0-100 Scale)
calculate_raw_weekly_indices <- function(df_group) {
  
  timeline_clean <- df_group %>%
    group_by(Datetime) %>%
    summarise(
      sleep_binary = first(sleep_binary), 
      light_binary = first(light_binary), 
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(Datetime) %>%
    mutate(Target_Tomorrow = Datetime + lubridate::hours(24))
  
  tomorrow_lookup <- timeline_clean %>% 
    select(Datetime, sleep_tomorrow = sleep_binary, light_tomorrow = light_binary)
  
  paired_data <- timeline_clean %>%
    left_join(tomorrow_lookup, by = c("Target_Tomorrow" = "Datetime")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(sleep_tomorrow) & !is.na(light_tomorrow))
  
  Total_Pairs <- nrow(paired_data)
  
  if (Total_Pairs == 0) {
    return(tibble(SRI = NA_real_, LRI = NA_real_))
  }
  
  sleep_matches <- sum(paired_data$sleep_binary == paired_data$sleep_tomorrow)
  light_matches <- sum(paired_data$light_binary == paired_data$light_tomorrow)
  
  # Standard Phillips Scaling
  sri_score <- (sleep_matches / Total_Pairs) * 100
  lri_score <- (light_matches / Total_Pairs) * 100
  
  return(tibble(SRI = sri_score, LRI = lri_score))
}
```

# 9. Create a Summary Statistics Table
This section generates the summary statistics and puts them into a publication-ready Microsoft Word table.
```{r, 9-summary-stats}

# ==============================================================================
# 9. SUMMARY STATISTICS TABLE 
# ==============================================================================

# --- Helper: Circular SD for Table ---
circular_sd_hours <- function(hours) {
  if(all(is.na(hours))) return(NA)
  rads <- hours * (2 * pi / 24)
  S <- sqrt(-log(abs(mean(exp(1i * rads), na.rm = TRUE))))
  return(S * (24 / (2 * pi)))
}

get_table_stats <- function(data) {
  
  # 1. Aggregation witCircular Logic
  stats_raw <- data %>%
    group_by(week) %>%
    summarise(across(where(is.numeric), list(
      mean = ~ {
        # Strict override: SRI and LRI are scalar scores (0 to 100), not daily times
        if(cur_column() %in% c("SRI", "LRI")) mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
        else if(grepl("hour|start|onset|Timing|LiT", cur_column(), ignore.case = TRUE)) circular_mean_hours(.x)
        else mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
      },
      sd = ~ {
        if(cur_column() %in% c("SRI", "LRI")) sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
        else if(grepl("hour|start|onset|Timing|LiT", cur_column(), ignore.case = TRUE)) circular_sd_hours(.x)
        else sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
      }
    )), .groups = "drop")
  
  # 2. Reshape long
  stats_long <- stats_raw %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -week, names_to = "metric", values_to = "val") %>%
    separate(metric, into = c("var", "stat"), sep = "_(?=[^_]+$)") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = stat, values_from = val)
  
  # 3. Precise Formatting Logic
  stats_formatted <- stats_long %>%
    mutate(mean_sd = case_when(
      # Format Regularity Scores cleanly to 1 decimal place: e.g., "78.4 (5.2)"
      var %in% c("SRI", "LRI") ~ sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", mean, sd),
      
      var == "avg_daily_missing" ~ {
        mean_pct <- mean * 100
        sd_pct   <- sd * 100
        sprintf("%.2f%% ± %.2f%% (%s ± %s)", 
                mean_pct, sd_pct,
                format_seconds_to_hhmm(mean * 1440 * 60), 
                format_seconds_to_hhmm(sd * 1440 * 60))
      },
      
      var %in% c("n_valid_days", "n_complete_days") ~ sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", mean, sd),
      var == "avg_wake_duration" ~ paste0(format_seconds_to_hhmm(mean * 3600), " (", format_seconds_to_hhmm(sd * 3600), ")"),
      var == "Dose_Lux_Hrs" ~ sprintf("%.0f (%.0f)", mean, sd),
      
      var %in% c("M10_act_avg", "L5_act_avg", "B10_GM_lux", "D5_GM_lux", 
                 "avg_wake_act", "avg_prebed_act", "avg_postwake_act",
                 "avg_wake_light", "avg_prebed_light", "avg_postwake_light") ~ sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean, sd),
        
      grepl("hour|start|onset|Timing|LiT", var, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ 
        paste0(format_seconds_to_hhmm(mean * 3600), " (", format_seconds_to_hhmm(sd * 3600), ")"),
        
      (grepl("Photo|TAT", var, ignore.case = TRUE) & !grepl("days", var)) ~ 
        paste0(format_seconds_to_hhmm(mean * 60), " (", format_seconds_to_hhmm(sd * 60), ")"),
        
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean, sd)
    )) %>%
    select(week, var, mean_sd)
  
  return(stats_formatted)
}

# ==============================================================================
# EXECUTION
# ==============================================================================

# 1. Generate the Automated 24h Sleep/Wake Classifications
# (This steps through and populates the raw combinations for SRI & LRI)
regularity_timeline_prepped <- final_imputed_all %>%
  mutate(
    id = str_pad(as.character(as.numeric(id)), 3, pad = "0"),
    Timepoint = as.character(Timepoint),
    Day = as.numeric(Day)
  ) %>%
  select(-any_of(c("philips_tac", "sleep_binary", "light_binary"))) %>%
  arrange(id, Datetime) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  mutate(
    philips_tac = slide_dbl(activity_imputed, philips_oakley_weights, .before = 4, .after = 4),
    philips_tac = if_else(is.na(philips_tac), activity_imputed, philips_tac),
    
    # 24h Automated Logic: Low activity AND Dark environmental conditions
    sleep_binary = if_else(philips_tac <= 40 & light_imputed < 50, 1, 0),
    light_binary = if_else(light_imputed > 100, 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 2. Run the Time-Matched Kronecker Delta function to build regularity_results
regularity_results <- regularity_timeline_prepped %>%
  mutate(
    week_label = case_when(
      week %in% c("1", "2", "3", "4") ~ as.character(week),
      TRUE ~ "BSL"
    ),
    week = factor(week_label, levels = c("BSL", "1", "2", "3", "4"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(id, week) %>%
  group_modify(~ calculate_raw_weekly_indices(.x)) %>%
  ungroup()

# 3. Compute Master Metrics (IS, IV, RA, etc.)
final_metrics_results <- compute_master_metrics_imputed(final_imputed_all)

# 4. Combine Master, Transition, and Regularity metrics 
final_metrics_combined <- final_metrics_results %>%
  mutate(week = as.character(week)) %>%
  # Join transition metrics (Wake, Pre-bed, etc.)
  left_join(wake_window_weekly %>% mutate(week = as.character(week)), by = c("id", "week")) %>%
  # Join Regularity Metrics safely as numeric scalars
  left_join(regularity_results %>% 
              mutate(week = as.character(week)) %>% 
              select(id, week, SRI, LRI), by = c("id", "week")) %>%
  mutate(across(c(SRI, LRI), as.numeric))

# 5. Generate Aggregated Table Summary Rows
final_imputed_stats <- get_table_stats(final_metrics_combined)

# 6. Wide Formatting and Lookup Alignment
final_summary_wide <- final_imputed_stats %>%
  inner_join(metric_lookup, by = "var") %>%
  mutate(
    Pretty_Name = factor(Pretty_Name, levels = metric_lookup$Pretty_Name),
    week = factor(week, levels = c("BSL", "1", "2", "3", "4"), 
                  labels = c("Baseline", "Week 1", "Week 2", "Week 3", "Week 4")),
    Category = factor(Category, levels = c("RECORDING DETAILS", "ACTIVITY METRICS", "LIGHT METRICS"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Category, Pretty_Name) %>% 
  select(Category, Variable = Pretty_Name, week, mean_sd) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = week, values_from = mean_sd) %>%
  relocate(Baseline, .after = Variable)

# 7. Flextable Compilation
ft <- final_summary_wide %>%
  arrange(Category) %>%
  as_grouped_data(groups = "Category") %>%
  flextable() %>%
  bold(i = ~ !is.na(Category), part = "body") %>%
  bg(i = ~ !is.na(Category), bg = "#F7F7F7", part = "body") %>%
  align(j = 2:ncol(final_summary_wide), align = "center", part = "all")

# 8. Apply Footnotes
ft <- ft %>%
  add_footer_lines(c(
    "[1] Lux/GM: Light intensity metrics are calculated as a Geometric Mean.",
    "[2] Start Hour/LiT: Modeled using Circular Statistics (FLiT = First, MLiT = Mean, LLiT = Last timing).",
    "[3] SRI/LRI: Calculated across continuous timelines using automated 24h dual-sensor classification constraints."
  )) %>%
  fontsize(size = 8, part = "footer") %>%
  italic(part = "footer")

final_summary_ft <- ft %>% autofit()
final_summary_ft
```

# 10. Data Visualisation 
This section creates bar plots of the key metrics. For the time-based metrics (onsets, photoperiod), we use circular statistics to calculate the mean and standard deviation, and we convert these into a more interpretable format (HH:MM) for the axis labels. The plots are designed to be publication-ready, with a consistent colour palette and clear labelling. We also create a polar histogram to visualise the distribution of onset times across the 24-hour cycle.
```{r, 10-data-vis, fig.width=9, fig.height=12}
# ==============================================================================
# 10. MASTER DATA VISUALISATION: ULTRA-TIGHT SPACING & FIXED AXES
# ==============================================================================
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
library(here)

# --- 1.  MATHS---
circular_mean_hours <- function(hours) {
  if(all(is.na(hours))) return(NA)
  rads <- hours * (2 * pi / 24)
  M <- atan2(mean(sin(rads), na.rm = TRUE), mean(cos(rads), na.rm = TRUE))
  mean_hour <- M * (24 / (2 * pi))
  if (mean_hour < 0) mean_hour <- mean_hour + 24
  return(mean_hour)
}

circular_sd_hours <- function(hours) {
  if(all(is.na(hours))) return(NA)
  rads <- hours * (2 * pi / 24)
  S <- sqrt(-log(abs(mean(exp(1i * rads), na.rm = TRUE))))
  return(S * (24 / (2 * pi)))
}

clean_plot_labels <- as_labeller(c(
  RA_act = "RA", IS_act = "IS", IV_act = "IV", 
  M10_act_avg = "M10", L5_act_avg = "L5", SRI = "SRI",
  avg_wake_act = "Wake Period Activity", 
  avg_postwake_act = "Activity 4hrs Post-Risetime", 
  avg_prebed_act = "Activity 4hrs Pre-Bedtime",
  RA_light = "RA", IS_light = "IS", IV_light = "IV", 
  B10_GM_lux = "B10", D5_GM_lux = "D5", LRI = "LRI",
  avg_wake_light = "Wake Lux", 
  avg_postwake_light = "Lux 4hrs Post-Risetime", 
  avg_prebed_light = "Lux 4hrs Pre-Bedtime",
  M10_start_hour = "M10 Onset", L5_start_hour = "L5 Onset",
  B10_start_hour = "B10 Onset", D5_start_hour = "D5 Onset",
  FLiT_250_avg = "FLiT", MLiT_250_avg = "MLiT", LLiT_250_avg = "LLiT",
  Dose_Lux_Hrs = "Lux-Hours", TAT_500_avg = "TAT 500", TAT_1000_avg = "TAT 1000",
  Photo_avg = "Photoperiod"
))

# --- 2. PLOT CONSTRUCTORS ---

# --- 1. Updated Bar Plot 
make_dynamic_bar <- function(data_raw, data_summary, vars_to_plot, y_lab, bar_color, num_cols) {
  df_raw <- data_raw %>% filter(Metric %in% vars_to_plot)
  df_sum <- data_summary %>% filter(Metric %in% vars_to_plot)
  
  ggplot() +
    geom_col(data = df_sum, aes(x = week, y = mean_val), fill = bar_color, alpha = 0.8, width = 0.7) +
    geom_jitter(data = df_raw, aes(x = week, y = Value), width = 0.15, alpha = 0.3, size = 0.7) +
    geom_errorbar(data = df_sum, aes(x = week, ymin = mean_val - sem_val, ymax = mean_val + sem_val), width = 0.2) +
    facet_wrap(~Metric, scales = "free_y", labeller = clean_plot_labels, ncol = num_cols, axes = "all") + 
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) + 
    theme_bw() + 
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
      axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
      axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6)
    ) +
    labs(y = y_lab)
}

# --- 2. Rose Plot

make_full_rose_wedges <- function(data_raw, data_summary, vars_to_plot, palette) {
  df_plot <- data_raw %>% filter(Metric %in% vars_to_plot)
  df_means <- data_summary %>% filter(Metric %in% vars_to_plot)
  
  ggplot() +
    geom_histogram(data = df_plot, aes(x = Value, fill = Metric), 
                   binwidth = 1.5, boundary = 0, alpha = 0.5, color = NA) +
    geom_segment(data = df_means, aes(x = mean_val, xend = mean_val, y = 0, yend = Inf, color = Metric), 
                 linewidth = 1.2) +
    coord_polar(start = 0, clip = "off") + 
    facet_wrap(~week, ncol = 5) + 
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 21, by = 3), limits = c(0, 24), expand = c(0,0),
                       labels = c("12a", "3a", "6a", "9a", "12p", "3p", "6p", "9p")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette, labels = clean_plot_labels) +
    scale_color_manual(values = palette, labels = clean_plot_labels) +
    theme_minimal() + 
    theme(
      axis.title = element_blank(), 
      axis.text.y = element_blank(), 
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7.5, color = "black"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      legend.position = "top", 
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(t = -10, b = 0, unit = "pt"),
      axis.line = element_blank() 
    )
}

make_tat_stacked <- function(metrics_df) {
  metrics_df %>%
    mutate(week = factor(week, levels = c("BSL", "1", "2", "3", "4"))) %>%
    select(id, week, TAT_500_avg, TAT_1000_avg) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = contains("TAT"), names_to = "Level", values_to = "Mins") %>%
    mutate(Level = factor(Level, levels = c("TAT_1000_avg", "TAT_500_avg"), labels = c(">1000lx", ">500lx"))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = week, y = Mins, fill = Level)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "summary", fun = mean, position = "stack", width = 0.7) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#2E5984", "#AED6F1")) + theme_classic() + 
    theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank(),
          axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)) + labs(title = "TAT", y = "Mins")
}

make_dose_curve <- function(imputed_df) {
  imputed_df %>%
    mutate(week = factor(week, levels = c("BSL", "1", "2", "3", "4"))) %>%
    group_by(id, week, TOD_min) %>%
    summarise(mean_lux = mean(light_imputed, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(id, week) %>% mutate(cum_lux = cumsum(mean_lux)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = TOD_min/60, y = cum_lux, color = week)) +
    geom_line(stat = "summary", fun = mean, linewidth = 1) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Blues", name = "Week") + 
    theme_classic() + 
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "top", 
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    ) + 
    labs(title = "Cumulative Dose", y = "Lux-Hrs")
}
```

# LMM Function
```{r, lmm}
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)
library(tidyverse)

format_seconds_to_hhmm <- function(seconds) {
  purrr::map_chr(seconds, function(s) {
    if (is.na(s)) return(NA_character_)
    
    is_neg <- s < 0
    abs_secs <- abs(s)
    
    hh <- floor(abs_secs / 3600)
    mm <- floor((abs_secs %% 3600) / 60)
    
    sign_str <- if(is_neg) "-" else ""
    sprintf("%s%02d:%02d", sign_str, hh, mm)
  })
}
# ==============================================================================
# 10. DAILY LEVEL LMM WITH WITHIN-SUBJECT COHEN'S D
# ==============================================================================

get_daily_lmm_stats <- function(df, metric_var, id_col = "id", week_col = "week") {
  
  # 1. Prepare Data
  df_mod <- df %>%
    rename(Id = all_of(id_col), Week_Orig = all_of(week_col)) %>%
    mutate(Value = as.numeric(.data[[metric_var]])) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Value)) %>%
    mutate(Week = factor(Week_Orig, levels = c("BSL", "1", "2", "3", "4")))

  if(nrow(df_mod) == 0) return(NULL)

  # 2. Fit Model
  fit <- lme4::lmer(Value ~ Week + (1|Id), data = df_mod, 
                    control = lmerControl(optimizer = "nloptwrap"))
  
  em <- emmeans::emmeans(fit, ~ Week)
  ct <- as.data.frame(emmeans::contrast(em, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = 1, infer = TRUE))
  
  # 3. Cohen's d (Within-subject)
  id_weekly_means <- df_mod %>%
    group_by(Id, Week) %>%
    summarise(m_val = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Week, values_from = m_val)

  cohen_d_results <- map_df(c("1", "2", "3", "4"), function(w) {
    if(w %in% names(id_weekly_means) && "BSL" %in% names(id_weekly_means)) {
      diffs <- na.omit(id_weekly_means[[w]] - id_weekly_means$BSL)
      d_val <- if(length(diffs) > 1) mean(diffs) / sd(diffs) else NA_real_
    } else { d_val <- NA_real_ }
    tibble(contrast_week = w, d = d_val)
  })

  # 4. Detect Timing Metrics for Circular Logic
  is_timing <- grepl("hour|start|LiT|_avg$", metric_var, ignore.case=TRUE) && 
               !grepl("days|missing|act_avg|L5_act|lux|Hrs|TAT", metric_var, ignore.case=TRUE)

  desc <- df_mod %>%
    group_by(Week) %>%
    summarise(
      m = if(is_timing) circular_mean_hours(Value) else mean(Value),
      s = if(is_timing) circular_sd_hours(Value) else sd(Value),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # 5. Formatting Rows
  bsl_row <- tibble(
    Week = "Baseline",
    Mean_SD = if(is_timing) 
                 paste0(format_seconds_to_hhmm(desc$m[desc$Week=="BSL"]*3600), " (", format_seconds_to_hhmm(desc$s[desc$Week=="BSL"]*3600), ")")
              else sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", desc$m[desc$Week=="BSL"], desc$s[desc$Week=="BSL"]),
    Diff = "", CI = "", d = ""
  )

  trt_rows <- ct %>%
    mutate(w_num = str_extract(contrast, "\\d")) %>%
    left_join(cohen_d_results, by = c("w_num" = "contrast_week")) %>%
    mutate(
      Week = paste("Week", w_num),
      Mean_SD = {
        idx <- match(w_num, desc$Week)
        if(is_timing) paste0(format_seconds_to_hhmm(desc$m[idx]*3600), " (", format_seconds_to_hhmm(desc$s[idx]*3600), ")")
        else sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", desc$m[idx], desc$s[idx])
      },
      Diff = if(is_timing) format_seconds_to_hhmm(estimate*3600) else sprintf("%.2f", estimate),
      CI = if(is_timing) paste0(format_seconds_to_hhmm(lower.CL*3600), " to ", format_seconds_to_hhmm(upper.CL*3600))
           else sprintf("%.2f to %.2f", lower.CL, upper.CL),
      d = sprintf("%.2f", d)
    ) %>%
    select(Week, Mean_SD, Diff, CI, d)

  return(bind_rows(bsl_row, trt_rows) %>% mutate(Metric = metric_var))
}

```

# Create LMM Results Table
```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=12}

# --- 1. Get Descriptive Stats for Recording Details ---
recording_vars <- metric_lookup %>% 
  filter(Category == "RECORDING DETAILS") %>% 
  pull(var)

recording_descriptives <- final_metrics_combined %>%
  group_by(week) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(intersect(recording_vars, colnames(.))), list(
    m = ~ if(grepl("Photo|Duration", cur_column())) circular_mean_hours(.x) else mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
    s = ~ if(grepl("Photo|Duration", cur_column())) circular_sd_hours(.x) else sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
  )), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -week, names_to = "metric_stat", values_to = "val") %>%
  separate(metric_stat, into = c("Metric", "stat"), sep = "_(?=[^_]+$)") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = stat, values_from = val) %>%
  mutate(
    Week = factor(week, levels = c("BSL", "1", "2", "3", "4"), 
                  labels = c("Baseline", "Week 1", "Week 2", "Week 3", "Week 4")),
    Mean_SD = case_when(
      grepl("missing", Metric) ~ sprintf("%.1f%%", m * 100),
      grepl("Photo|Duration", Metric) ~ paste0(format_seconds_to_hhmm(m*3600), " (", format_seconds_to_hhmm(s*3600), ")"),
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", m, s)
    ),
    Diff = "", CI = "", d = "" 
  ) %>%
  select(Metric, Week, Mean_SD, Diff, CI, d)
# Define analysis set (excluding recording details)
target_vars <- metric_lookup %>% 
  filter(Category != "RECORDING DETAILS") %>% 
  pull(var)

# Filter for variables 
existing_vars <- intersect(target_vars, colnames(final_metrics_combined))

# Run loop
all_lmm_results <- map_df(existing_vars, ~get_daily_lmm_stats(final_metrics_combined, .x))

# Generate Table

final_combined_results <- bind_rows(recording_descriptives, all_lmm_results)

# --- 3. Create the Final Flextable ---
lmm_master_report <- final_combined_results %>%
  inner_join(metric_lookup, by = c("Metric" = "var")) %>%
  select(Category, Variable = Pretty_Name, Week, Mean_SD, Diff, CI, d) %>%
  # Ensure Week is a character for clean display in Baseline rows
  mutate(across(c(Diff, CI, d), ~if_else(Week == "Baseline", "", .x))) %>%
  as_grouped_data(groups = "Category") %>%
  flextable() %>%
  bold(i = ~ !is.na(Category), part = "body") %>%
  bg(i = ~ !is.na(Category), bg = "#F7F7F7", part = "body") %>%
  merge_v(j = "Variable") %>% 
  valign(j = "Variable", valign = "top") %>%
  set_header_labels(Mean_SD = "Mean (SD)", Diff = "Adj diff", d = "ES (d)") %>%
  hline(i = ~ !is.na(Variable), part = "body", border = officer::fp_border(color="gray80")) %>%
  
  # Re-add footnotes 
  footnote(i = ~ grepl("Hour|Timing|Onset|FLiT|MLiT|LLiT", Variable), j = 2,
           value = as_paragraph("Circular statistics used for timing."), ref_symbols = "1") %>%
  footnote(i = ~ grepl("Lux|GM", Variable), j = 2,
           value = as_paragraph("Geometric mean on log-transformed data."), ref_symbols = "2") %>%
  footnote(i = ~ grepl("Stability|Variability|Amplitude|Index|SRI|LRI", Variable), j = 2,
           value = as_paragraph("Weekly-level rhythm metrics."), ref_symbols = "3") %>%
  autofit()

# --- 4. Export to Word ---
doc <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_par("Actigraphy & Light Summary Table", style = "heading 1") %>%
  body_add_flextable(lmm_master_report) 

print(doc, target = paste0("Full_Actigraphy_Results_", Sys.Date(), ".docx"))
```
